python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/eval_safelibero_object_all_levelII_30000_lora_baseline_seed7.json'))
tasks = d['results']
total_eps = 0
total_frozen = 0
for t in tasks:
    name = t['task_name']
    frozen = sum(1 for e in t['episodes'] if e['max_ee_displacement'] < 0.01)
    total_frozen += frozen
    total_eps += t['n_episodes']
    print(f'{name}: TSR={t[\"TSR\"]:.1%} CAR={t[\"CAR\"]:.1%} avg_max_disp={t[\"avg_max_displacement\"]:.4f} avg_max_ee_disp={t[\"avg_max_ee_displacement\"]:.4f} frozen={frozen}/{t[\"n_episodes\"]}')
avg_tsr = sum(t['TSR'] for t in tasks) / len(tasks)
avg_car = sum(t['CAR'] for t in tasks) / len(tasks)
avg_ee = sum(t['avg_max_ee_displacement'] for t in tasks) / len(tasks)
avg_disp = sum(t['avg_max_displacement'] for t in tasks) / len(tasks)
frozen_rate = total_frozen / total_eps
dfcar = avg_car if frozen_rate == 0 else avg_car * (1 - frozen_rate)
print(f'---')
print(f'Avg TSR={avg_tsr:.1%}')
print(f'Avg CAR={avg_car:.1%}')
print(f'frozen_rate={frozen_rate:.1%} ({total_frozen}/{total_eps})')
print(f'dfCAR={dfcar:.1%}')
print(f'avg_max_ee_displacement={avg_ee:.4f}')
print(f'avg_max_displacement={avg_disp:.4f}')
"
